title: Playboy Magazine Lot of 4 2002 2004 2007 Tiffany Brooke + 1 Random Magazine
descriptionText:
Description:

Lot of 4 vintage Playboy magazines from the 2000s featuring celebrity and special issues.

Includes:

• April 2002 – Tiffany cover / Sex & Music Issue / Lennox Lewis interview / Michael Imperioli
• June 2002 – Playmate of the Year Dalene Kurtis / Shakira feature / Curt Schilling interview / Oscar De La Hoya
• November 2004 – Brooke Burke cover / Oliver Stone interview
• October 2007 – Alicia Machado / Girls of the SEC / Wild Southern College Girls issue

The April and June 2002 issue details are consistent with Playboy issue indexes, including Tiffany as the April cover feature and Dalene Kurtis as the 2002 Playmate of the Year. 

Pre-owned magazines with normal signs of age, storage and handling. Covers may have light scratches, scuffs, edge/corner wear, creasing or other cosmetic wear. Overall condition appears nice for their age.

Please review all photos carefully for exact condition. Sold as a lot of 4 magazines exactly as pictured.
